note: London is framed week on week and year on year rather than against target: the FY26/27 weekly targets were set before the Shard's traffic shift and the Dim Sum Library rebrand, so variance to them is not a clean read, and DSL is flagged not comparable for the same reason. London booked 2,687 GA4 bookings, up 3.7 percent week on week and down 13.0 percent year on year. The whole of that year-on-year gap sits in Aqua Shard, which is 707 bookings below last year; the other five venues together are up 22.8 percent year on year. Users fell year on year at every venue except Azzurra, but conversion rose at Hutong, Regent St and Shiro Sushi, so this reads as a traffic problem rather than a booking-journey one. Covers are reported alongside these figures because total_payment is unreliable in London and GA4 cannot see OpenTable.
